concepts.quote: There is a Big.class file now, but nothing is printed
concepts.why: Applies to Big.java the rule that the text yields Big.class from javac and produces no output until it is run.

concepts.quote: nothing is printed because the program has not run yet
concepts.why: Relates the compile step to the run step: output appears only when java Big executes the class javac produced, so a successful compile alone prints nothing.

concepts.quote: There is a Big.class file now
concepts.why: Applies to this program that a successful javac changes only the file system (creates Big.class) and prints no program output; premise of success is taken from the question as asked.
